articles.summary: Three-time public company CEO brings more than 30 years in energy and oilfield services, with a proven record of operational rigor and disciplined capital allocation Executive Chairman Richard Hubbell to retire at year-end; Patrick Gunning appointed Non-Executive Chairman of the Board ATLANTA, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — RPC, Inc. (NYSE: RES), a leading diversified oilfield services company, today announced the appointment of Rob Saltiel as President and Chief Executive Officer, and as a member of the Board of Directors effective November 20, 2026. Mr. Saltiel will succeed Ben M. Palmer, whose planned retirement was announced in June 2026, after 30 years with RPC. Mr. Saltiel brings more than three decades of leadership experience across the energy and oilfield services sectors, including serving as CEO of multiple publicly traded companies. Most recently, Mr. Saltiel served as President and CEO of MRC Global from 2021 through its merger with DNOW in 2025. Under Mr. Saltiel’s leadership at MRC, the company significantly improved its margin profile while diversifying its business toward less cyclical and higher-growth end markets. articles.title: RPC, Inc. Appoints Rob Saltiel as President and Chief Executive Officer
